description: This file contains the PHP source code for the GeoZone model class within the Opencart admin localisation namespace. It defines methods for CRUD operations and data retrieval related to geographical zones in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Model class for managing geographical zones within the OpenCart localisation system, including CRUD operations, data retrieval, and association with country and zone data.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Inserts a new geo zone record into the database and associates zones to it if provided.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Updates an existing geo zone record and its zone associations based on provided data.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Deletes a geo zone and its zone associations from the database.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific geo zone by its ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geo zones, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalGeoZones
methods.description: Returns the total count of geo zones.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Associates a zone with a geo zone based on country and zone IDs.

methods.name: deleteZones
methods.description: Deletes all zone associations for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Retrieves all zones associated with a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Returns the count of zone associations for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Returns the total number of zones associated with a specific country.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByZoneId
methods.description: Returns the count of zone associations for a specific zone.
